messages:
samir: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 502/504 + timeouts to hosted inference in us-west starting ~09:12 PDT. Support ticket INC-4721. Opening this thread to coordinate mitigation.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-4721. Pager duty notified (oncall/infra).

lee: Seeing a hard spike in gateway 502s from edge-proxy logs. Error: "connection reset by peer" from backend pool. Gateway CPU looks normal but connection_count at 95th is very high.

gloria: KV-cache hit spikes at the same time — per-shard latency increased. Suspect KV stall + proxy pool exhaustion causing upstream resets.

samir: Mitigation suggestion: route affected model endpoints to a lighter fallback variant and enable ingress shedding for tail requests. Can we do a quick route policy flip?

karim: Initiating rollback of the egress idle-timeout change (commit c3f9a2) that went out at ~09:09. Rolling back in canary then us-west. ETA ~3m.

gloria: Also propose enabling circuit-breaker on ingress to shed slow inflight requests while we stabilize.

karim: Rollback command running now.

lee: Scaling gateway replicas x2 and bumping connection pool cap to 1000 for us-west. Applying k8s change now.

support-ops: We're patching customer-facing updates into INC-4721 & INC-4722: recommended workaround is to retry with exponential backoff and reduce client batch_size where possible. We'll attach repro request examples.

karim: Rollback succeeded at 1763456895. Observing initial reduction in 502s.

oncall-bot: Metrics update: error-rate peaked 6.3% at 09:16, down to 0.8% at 09:26. p95 latency down from 1.9s to 0.9s.

gloria: Correlation note — redis-sidecar image bumped at 09:10 in same cluster. I'll pull traces and redis latency heatmaps.

samir: Quick debug snippets: enable debug logs on proxy and capture 5xx traces.

```
# enable debug (example)
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/edge-proxy -c proxy --since=10m > /tmp/edge-proxy-debug.log
```

gloria: I'll own the postmortem timeline and evidence collection (traces, logs, config diffs). Draft due by Tue 03/24.

lee: I'll own the circuit-breaker RFC and a canary rollout plan (due Mon 03/23). Will add automated metric alerts for connection-pool usage.

karim: I'll add per-kv-shard healthchecks and surface latency percentiles to the console; target Mon 03/23.

support-ops: We'll update the public support playbook with explicit model-fallback steps, retry/backoff examples, and the customer communication template — target Fri 03/20. We'll collect repro curl commands + headers from affected customers; please add any missing logs.

samir: Action items recap (owners + due dates):
- postmortem + timeline: gloria — Tue 03/24
- ingress circuit-breaker default: lee — Mon 03/23
- KV shard healthchecks + telemetry: karim — Mon 03/23
- support playbook & customer comms: support-ops — Fri 03/20

samir: Closing this live thread for the immediate war-room; tracking in INC-4721. If anything regresses, ping here and I'll re-open. :white_check_mark:

lee: thx all — monitoring. :eyes:

gloria: adding initial timeline notes to the postmortem doc.

support-ops: customers notified, updating tickets with rollback notes.
